issues: The job script requests 8 tasks via '#FLUX --ntasks=8' but does not use a parallel launcher like 'flux run' or 'mpirun' to execute the main workload. The command '/lfs/h1/nos/nosofs/noscrub/$LOGNAME/packages/nosofs.${nosofs_ver}/jobs/JNOS_OFS_PREP' will run as a single serial process on only one of the 8 allocated tasks, leaving the other 7 tasks idle. This leads to significant resource underutilization. If the application is parallel, it should be launched with 'flux run -n 8 ...'. If it is serial, the resource request should be changed to '#FLUX --ntasks=1'.
